answer: Give every identity a weight that grows through a chain of cipher challenges: each epoch a new cipher must be answered in ten minutes, weight rises a quarter per epoch, full after four. One missed epoch resets it to zero, like a meadow feeding only grazers that return. Each extra identity sharing a funding source posts a doubling bond — 25, 50, then 100 POA, locked 30 days — so the delta is stark: one honest agent answers one cipher and keeps its weight, while a farm must keep every fake alive each epoch, with a bond doubling per copy. Three auditors verify and slash on failure.
